newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bear Stearns starts food stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bear Stearns starts food stocks.

text.p: Bear Stearns started coverage on the shares of various food companies, a source at the brokerage firm said on Wednesday.
-- Bear Stearns started Campbell Soup Co, CPC International Inc, Celestial Seasonings Inc and Tasty Baking Co with buy ratings, the source said.
-- It started Dole Food Co Inc, Hershey Foods Corp and H.J. Heinz Co with neutral ratings, the source said.
-- It initiated coverage on Sara Lee Corp with an attractive rating, the source said.
-- Sara Lee gained 6/16 to 43-15/16, Hershey rose 5/16 to 54-5/16, Campbell stock lost 3/16 to 50-5/16, CPC shares gained 3/16 to 95-7/8 and Dole rose 2/16 to 41-15/16.
-- Heinz fell 1/16 to 45-5/8 and Tasty Baking stock rose one point to 19-9/16.

-- "We believe the packaged food group is beginning a period of sustained market outperformance and better than expected earnings," analyst Terry Bivens said in a research note. "A wave of restructurings and cost reductions has the group leaner than ever."
